checks.title: Every file has exactly one owner, and the owner is a declared role
Project files, the solution, dependency manifests, CI and deployment are owned by integration
Compile order is predefined: a file depends only on earlier files of its project or on referenced projects, and project references are acyclic
Every interface has a complete contract implemented by one file its producer owns, and the compile order lists each once in file order
The save-state interface has exactly the states of SM-SAVE (no new persistence state)
The GitHub error matrix covers every required class completely; a shared HTTP status is never the only evidence; retries stay within the PERSIST-010/016 bounds; every test exists in the plan
The Forma layout contract uses only tokens, patterns and breakpoints of the published Forma release, and the committed inventory equals the one extracted from the package
Coordination telemetry defines every required metric with a source, keeps textual conflicts apart from semantic failures, and records unavailable metrics instead of estimating them
The verification execution plan places every (obligation, test) binding of the plan in exactly one suite, keeping each test and its assertions
Every requirement, P0 obligation and test binding of v4 is preserved unchanged
No v4.1 input imports or names application source from an earlier rehearsal
Every state machine is deterministic and complete: each (state, event) pair is legal with distinct guards or fails closed, every state is reachable, no state is added
The adjusted DAG is acyclic, keeps every v4 task with its requirements and estimate, and every adjustment is a labelled estimate with a rationale
Every bound test identity names an owned test file, or is a Praxis record that is not code
